verses.text: King David ruled from Hebron for seven years and six months, and during that time he had six sons, who were born in the following order: Amnon, Daniel, Absalom, Adonijah, Shephatiah, and Ithream. Ahinoam from Jezreel was the mother of Amnon; Abigail from Carmel was the mother of Daniel; Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur was the mother of Absalom; Haggith was the mother of Adonijah; Abital was the mother of Shephatiah; and Eglah was the mother of Ithream. David then ruled from Jerusalem for 33 years,
and during that time, he had 13 more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.

footnotes.text: Bathsheba: Two ancient translations (see also 2 Samuel 11); Hebrew “Bathshua.”

verses.text: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

footnotes.text: Elishua: Some Hebrew manuscripts and some manuscripts of one ancient translation (see also 2 Samuel 5.14,15); most Hebrew manuscripts “Elishama.”

verses.text: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter.

footnotes.text: other wives: See the note at 2.46.

verses.text: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.

footnotes.text: Jehoram: The Hebrew text has “Joram,” another spelling of the name.
Jehoahaz: The Hebrew text has “Shallum,” probably another name for Jehoahaz (see also 2 Kings 23.30).

verses.text: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah,

footnotes.text: Shecaniah: One possible meaning for the difficult Hebrew text of verse 21.

verses.text: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
